description: Passthrough to any BrAPI GET /{path} endpoint. Returns the raw upstream envelope without enrichment or foreign-key resolution. Emits a `suggestion` field when a curated tool exists for the same data. Spills to a canvas dataframe when the upstream advertises more rows than `loadLimit` AND the result is a list shape (`result` array or `result.data` envelope) — read it with brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL); inline `result` is unchanged. Skips spillover when the caller drives paging via `params.page` / `params.pageSize`.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. Rows beyond the cap land in a dataframe; query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

params.description: Query parameters to append. Arrays are repeated per BrAPI convention.

path.description: Endpoint path — e.g. "/samples", "/methods". Leading "/" is optional.

name: brapi_raw_get

dataframe.description: The pages of a list-shaped result, staged when the upstream advertised more rows than `loadLimit`. The inline `result` is unchanged.

columnLegend.description: Sanitized column name → original upstream key, present only when a column was renamed to be SQL-safe (e.g. `end` → `end_`). SQL uses the sanitized names.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time the dataframe metadata is purged; copy rows out before, or re-run the producing tool.

maxRows.description: Row cap that ended the pull, present only when that cap fired.

tableName.description: Table name for brapi_dataframe_describe and brapi_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Upstream-reported row total, when known; can exceed rowCount.

truncated.description: True when the dataframe holds less than the upstream reports: a cap, failed page, deadline, or short upstream ended the pull, or it was skipped. warnings says which. Absent otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `cross_origin_path`: path argument was a full URL instead of a relative BrAPI route. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

metadata.description: BrAPI envelope metadata (pagination and any additional upstream fields).

pagination.description: BrAPI pagination block. Absent when the endpoint does not paginate.

totalCount.description: Total rows matching the query across all pages.

totalPages.description: Total pages at the current pageSize.

notice.description: When a dataframe was staged, its name and the tools that read it.

path.description: Normalized path (leading `/` preserved) that was appended to the baseUrl.

result.description: Raw BrAPI `result` value — whatever shape the endpoint returns.

suggestion.description: Emitted when a curated goal-shaped tool covers this endpoint, or takes the IDs it lists.

url.description: Fully resolved URL that was fetched (baseUrl + path + query string).

warnings.description: Advisory messages — present when the dataframe walk stopped before the upstream total.

title: Brapi Raw Get
